quarterly_data.signal: AI / IT growth businesses (Transformation toward Nidec Reform deck, new management): Nidec plans to capitalize on data-center expansion in its power generation / storage / conversion and storage / cooling-module businesses and to execute growth investments. As laid out on the slide (period not stated): HDD components - global No. 1 share in the HDD spindle motor market (company claim), 2026 DC-oriented HDD market growth rate approx. 14%; water-cooling modules - No.1 CDU cooling capacity as a Japanese manufacturer (company claim), net sales growth approx. 40%; generators - global No.1 share in the alternator market (company claim), net sales growth approx. 40%; BESS - 15% share in the global top 5 of the BESS market, sales growth approx. 40%; converters - global top 5 share 16%, sales growth approx. 40%.
quarterly_data.figure: DC-oriented HDD market growth approx. 14% (2026); water-cooling module, generator, BESS and converter sales growth approx. 40% each; BESS share 15%; converter share 16%

quarterly_data.signal: Restatement and FY2025 (year to March 2026) detail, new-management deck: the FY2020-FY2024 cumulative operating profit was restated from 819.9 billion yen to 437.3 billion yen (total corrections -382.6 billion yen, including -174.2 billion yen from the Third-Party Committee findings and -288.0 billion yen of impairment losses); net assets at end-March 2025 decreased by 476.9 billion yen versus pre-correction figures and the equity ratio was 42.5% (51.8% before correction), and dividends for the fiscal years ended March 2021 through March 2025 exceeded the restated distributable amount. FY2025: equity ratio 25.6%, free cash flow 98.0 billion yen, cash and cash equivalents 852.2 billion yen; major impairments ACIM 298.8 billion yen (40-50% of home-appliance supply capacity became surplus), Nidec PSA emotors (NPe) 116.3 billion yen (order volumes from key customer Stellantis declined through FY24-25) and Nidec Mobility (NMOJ) 73.1 billion yen. Direction: shift resources from low-profit home-appliance and automotive businesses to energy and infrastructure, AI and semiconductor and machine-tool fields; the new management team will develop the mid-term plan; Nidec aims to complete the remaining tasks to obtain audit opinions by the end of October.
quarterly_data.figure: restated FY2020-FY2024 operating profit 437.3 billion yen (819.9 before; -382.6 corrections); net assets -476.9 billion yen; FY2025 equity ratio 25.6%, FCF 98.0 billion yen; impairments ACIM 298.8, NPe 116.3, NMOJ 73.1 billion yen
